visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands on an outdoor urban street at night, looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a high-definition CGI dinosaur extending its long neck against a blue sky with a person's back in the foreground. (3) The woman is back on the street, gesturing with open palms. (4) Shots of people cheering with champagne, a hot air balloon rising with fire, and two people ziplining over a lush green forest. (5) Close-up of a Tyrannosaurus Rex head near a vehicle. (6) The woman returns to the street setting, pointing upwards and then at herself. (7) Footage of a green jeep driving through a forest. A woman inside looks surprised. (8) Information screens appear with Japanese text, maps, and car graphics, overlaid on a blurred background. (9) A bus is shown on an info screen with maps of Okinawa. (10) Shots of a girl smiling, a family dining in a high-altitude nest overlooking a forest, and people laughing together. (11) A woman enjoys a spa at night, looking out over a forest with a dinosaur silhouette in the distance. (12) Montage of food items: dinosaur-themed buns, corn, a meat dish, and colorful drinks. (13) The woman on the street concludes her talk, waving goodbye.
